prompt:
CAMERA: 35mm cinema lens, locked-off and completely static for the whole shot. The camera never moves, never pans, never pushes in, never pulls back, never shows itself.
LOOK: match the reference frame's grade EXACTLY: dim night interior, heavily desaturated near-monochrome, deep grey shadows, no daylight, no bright walls, real film grain. The ONLY colored element in the entire video is one tiny highlighter-yellow point at the fingertip.
STYLE: cinematic brand film, slow, held, precise. No glow, no neon, no lens flare, no light particles: every dot is a matte physical grain, like a halftone made of real grains.
CHARACTER: NO FACE anywhere, no head, no body, no person, no second person, nobody walks through frame. The only human presence is ONE right hand and forearm in a plain dark sweater sleeve, made of thousands of small matte grey grains gathered into the shape of a hand. Same hand and same dark sweater in every shot. The hand never walks away and never leaves toward the back of the room.
SETTING: a closed retail store at night, no people, shutters down behind the glass, a checkout counter with a card terminal and a dark screen showing only abstract grey blocks.
CONSTRAINT: absolutely no letters, no words, no numbers, no signage, no handwriting, no typing of text. Keep text-bearing objects out of frame: no printed documents with visible type, no labels, no posters, no logos, no watermarks, no subtitles. CRITICAL: the wall and the area above and behind the counter stay EMPTY — no shop sign, no hanging board, no illuminated panel, no menu board, no framed plate, nothing mounted in the upper right of the frame. The upper third of the frame is bare dark wall. Any screen, paper or panel shows ONLY abstract grey bars, blocks, ticks and blank cells. Nothing is ever written or spelled. No colored element besides the single yellow point.
SCENES: the shot is 4 seconds long and the LAST TWO SECONDS are entirely a dissolve.
1. (0.0-1.2s, wide, static) From the LEFT edge grey grains fly in along three thin converging lines toward the counter, one tiny yellow point leading, and GATHER into a right hand and dark-sleeved forearm above the card terminal.
2. (1.2-2.0s, same static frame) The hand presses the card terminal once and an empty grey block on its screen fills solid, one soft confirmation.
3. (2.0-4.0s, same static frame) THE DISSOLVE. This is the main event of the shot and it takes a full two seconds. The hand and the whole forearm break apart into thousands of separate matte grey grains that drift apart and stream out to the right. By 3.0 seconds the limb is already unrecognisable as a hand. By 3.5 seconds only a thin scatter of drifting grains remains.
FINAL FRAME REQUIREMENT (most important instruction in this prompt): the very last frame of the video shows an EMPTY counter. There is no hand, no fingers, no wrist, no forearm, no sleeve, no arm resting anywhere in the picture. Nothing solid and photographic remains where the hand was. If a hand is visible on the last frame the shot is wrong.
